mirth-channel-skeleton.name: SOMERSET_MDT
mirth-channel-skeleton.summary: Processes Somerset MDT meeting, booking, and note extracts and writes MDT discussions using cached meeting context.

runtime-notes.note: Process `somerset_mdt_meetings_*.csv` before bookings and notes so the meeting cache is populated.
The transformer uses `globalMap` to cache meeting metadata across the three Somerset MDT extract types.

destinations.destination: Dispatch row handling by filename and join meeting metadata to pathway context.
Upsert MDT discussion for booking and note rows.
